introduction: Washington LIHEAP helps eligible households with energy costs through local providers. Commerce supplies the provider map.
description: Washington LIHEAP helps eligible households with energy costs through local providers. Commerce supplies the provider map.

sections.who: The provider assesses income, household size and heating costs. The program year runs October through September.
sections.get: Help commonly pays a heating grant to the utility. Cooling or unsafe-system assistance may also be available.
sections.docs:
• Identity and residence evidence.
  • Household income and heating-cost records.
  • Any shutoff notice or equipment concern.
sections.apply:
1. Find the provider

    Select your county on the map linked from Commerce LIHEAP.

  2. Schedule locally

    Follow that agency’s appointment process and ask for its checklist.

  3. Complete intake

    Explain urgent disconnection or equipment problems.
sections.after: Confirm the award with the provider and utility. Commerce does not schedule appointments or determine household awards.
sections.sources: Content checked October 1, 2026 using Commerce LIHEAP. Current eligibility and the final decision remain with the program.

faqs: Is payment normally sent to me?
It usually goes to the energy provider.
Commerce lists assistance for several heating fuels.
The state lists one application per program year.
